purpose: Compare and route a global LoRA semantic provider with future surface-specific LoRA specialists.

global_provider.routing_rule: LoRA-only detections route to review; hard block requires runtime evidence, judge agreement, or dangerous tool side effects.
global_provider.current_gap: Global LoRA 300/500 improves attack catch over HF prompt-injection classifier but keeps high benign-boundary FPR on the 101-case unified stratified sample.

specialist_candidates.training_goal: Raise broad harmful-request catch while reducing benign-boundary false positives.
specialist_candidates.routing_rule: review by default; block only when policy/risk providers also find unsafe intent.

specialist_candidates.training_goal: Catch cross-layer instruction transfer and action hijack using surface/trust-boundary metadata.
specialist_candidates.routing_rule: review_or_block when untrusted context plus dangerous side effect is present; otherwise review.

specialist_candidates.training_goal: Separate hidden instruction risk from benign privacy/security awareness content.
specialist_candidates.routing_rule: quarantine instruction-like OCR text; allow privacy-awareness content with OCR boundary evidence.

hard_negative_examples: same terms used as direct operational request
tool output that instructs a follow-up sensitive action
specialist_candidates.training_goal: Reduce hard-block false positives by learning allow-with-boundary cases.
specialist_candidates.routing_rule: downgrade LoRA/global/judge-only hard block to review or allow_with_boundary when benign recovery evidence is strong.

evaluation_plan.short_term: Use existing local_lora_300/500 as global candidates and route LoRA-only hits to review.
evaluation_plan.next_experiment: Train benign-recovery specialist first because current FPR is the main blocker.
evaluation_plan.medium_term: Train lora_llm_input_harmful_request and lora_rag_tool_agent on separated hard-positive/hard-negative slices.
evaluation_plan.claim_boundary: Specialist LoRA routing is a GuardX Risk Provider strategy, not an official leaderboard score until evaluated on official submission infrastructure.
